calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-20-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Commissioner: Loretta M. Norris, Clerk: P. Dias, Reporter: Robert Balian, Bailiff: Henry. Petitioner Rosalua Chamo was sworn and examined. Also present, Edgar Gonzales, father sworn and examined through Spanish Interpreter, Gerara Almendaros. Court suggested to Petitioner to file with the Court copies of Declaration of biological father and the Birth Certificate. Court grants decree changing minor's name to Valerie Rosemary Gonzalez. Decree signed.
